outputs.explanation: Panel A shows a single macroscopic image per genotype presented as evidence of a phenotypic difference, but the caption does not state how many mice were examined/imaged to support this comparison or that the images are representative of a stated number of animals.

Panel B shows H&E-stained 'Swiss roll' sections from a single mouse per genotype. The caption gives no indication of how many mice or sections were examined, so the number and type of replicates underlying this representative comparison are not reported.

Panel E includes a quantitative bar graph of GTP-bound Rac1 and Cdc42 with error bars, implying repeated measurements, but the caption does not state the number or type of replicates (e.g., independent experiments or animals) used to generate the error bars.

Panel F shows representative immunohistochemistry images for pJNK, MMP9 and Asef/Asef2 per genotype without any statement of how many mice or sections were analysed to support the depicted comparison.

Panel G includes a quantification bar graph ('Relative expression') with error bars and statistical significance markers for Asef, pJNK1 and MMP9, but the caption does not report the number or type of replicates underlying this quantification.
